other_positions: Quarter-duration start/middle/end are separately reported sensitivity controls, not independent bases.
unsupported_denominator: All preregistered bases remain in the end-to-end mean; unsupported and failed entries have zero contribution and explicit status. Detection-conditioned means report their changed denominator.
sensitivity_gate: clean > subject_corrupt for every backend on the same base
ratio_population: Secondary R: common bases passing subject drop >= 0.05 in every compared column, with all exclusions reported.
criterion: Masked absolute-change CI upper bound < 0.02 and paired reduction CI lower bound > 0. Subject-corruption sensitivity must also be reported; background stability alone does not establish a useful metric.
aggregation_repair: Published implementation: 0.5 adjacent + 0.5 all_pairs; preserve as shipped.
masked_repair: All_pairs, clamped nonnegative cosines; zero uses fixed C(T,2).
background_support: Binary complement of the designated subject mask, covering every other pixel.
primary_statistic: Median absolute score(clean)-score(background_corrupt) on common bases; paired official-minus-masked reduction in absolute change.
ratio_interpretation: Background and subject interventions have unequal areas. The former equal-area official-CI-contains-1 criterion is not applicable.
